title: Agentic AI Reasoning and Learned Sampling for Task-Aware Projection Selection in Sparse-View CT: Predicting Hemodynamics
summary: On simulated aneurysm CTA, task-aware view masks lower spatially resolved TAWSS errors at extreme sparsity, while prediction-optimal masks reconstruct images poorly. This is the result-bearing preprint version dated 2026-10-28; peer-review status is not established by the reviewed source.
ai_technology: A Fourier neural operator predicts wall-shear stress from simulated sparse CTA projections; Gumbel, Soft top-K and an agentic selector choose views.
organization: University of Utah; University of Wisconsin–Milwaukee

evidence.tested: On simulated aneurysm CTA, task-aware view masks lower spatially resolved TAWSS errors at extreme sparsity, while prediction-optimal masks reconstruct images poorly. CFD-derived synthetic aneurysm CTA uses five-run comparisons and independent agent searches across view budgets; results do not establish patient or clinical validity.
evidence.unknown: not establish patient or clinical validity.
